The '''Umbaran support ship''', also known as the '''Separatist support ship''', was used during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] to support the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist armada]] clashing with the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and to protect a [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|Separatist supply ship]] sending long range missiles to support the local Umbaran militia.
